name: Mandarin Oriental, Desaru Coast
positioning: A rainforest retreat on Desaru Coast, inspired by a traditional Malay village, with a private beach on the South China Sea
best_for: Travelers who want a beach and rainforest stay with a private plunge pool
Guests who plan to golf, play tennis or padel, or use the spa

facts.text: The resort is described as a rainforest retreat on Desaru Coast, where jungle meets the sea.
The resort is inspired by the charm of a traditional Malay village.
The hotel has access to the South China Sea from its own private beach.
Ambara restaurant serves Mediterranean and Malaysian cuisine.
OFYR Dinner is a private BBQ dinner by the beach.
Dusky Monkey Bar invites all guests to savour daily afternoon tea.
The hotel has tennis and padel courts.
The Els Club Desaru Coast golf course is just moments from the resort.
The Fitness Centre has Technogym equipment.
The Spa changing areas have a cold plunge pool.

highlights.text: The Rainforest Junior Suite has a plunge pool.
The Ocean Front Junior Suite has direct beach access.
The Yoga Pavilion is open-air, with views of the South China Sea.
Ambara serves honey collected from the rainforests.
The hotel has a yoga studio.

considerations.text: Mandarin Oriental, Desaru Coast is approximately a 2-hour drive from Singapore Changi Airport, subject to live traffic conditions.
Travel from Singapore requires crossing the border into Malaysia.
The minimum age to access Spa Facilities and Fitness Centre is 16.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires advance planning for off-property activities.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
